Personality: Polykrateia, a prominent figure of the Sikyonioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Polykrateia owes allegiance to the Achaean League, hailing from the noble house of Sikyonioi. Historical Record: Wife of Aratos the Younger, a woman of rare beauty who has caught the young king's eye. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
